Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
CHAIN WHEEL ROTARY TOOTH FORM 
MILLING CUTTER 



1. Scope — Covers the dimensions and requirements for chainwheel rotary tooth form milhng cutters, 
suitable for chainwheels according to IS : 2403-1975 'Specification for transmission steel roller chams 
and chain wheels {first revision)', 

2. Dimensions — Shall be as given in Table 1 and Table 2.

Note — The figure is indicative of dimensions only and does not specify design features. 



3. General Requirements 

3.1 Dimensions of keyways shall be according to IS : 6285-1971 'Dimensions for interchangeability of 
milling cutters and milling arbors with key drive'. 

3.2 For requirements not covered in this standard it shall conform to the requirements as given in 
IS : 1830-1982 Technical supply conditions for milling cutters (second revision)'. 

4. Sampling — The sampling and criteria of acceptance shall be in accordance with IS : 7778-1975 
'Method for sampling small tools'. 

5. Designation — A chainwheel rotary tooth form milling cutter with roller diameter di^b mm, having 
9 to 12 teeth, made from high speed steel and conforming to this standard shall be designated as : 

Chainwheel Milling Cutter 5-9 to 12 IS : 10465 

6. Maximum Permissible Radial and Axial Runout — Shall be as given below :

18:10466-1982 

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

The dimensions and requirements for chainwheels milling cutters were earlier covered In 
IS : 2403. While taking up the first revision of IS : 2403 in 1975Mhe requirements of chainwheel 
milling cutters were deleted. Therefore, taking into consideration the necessity of having an Indian 
Standard on chainwheel form milling cutters. Small Tools Sectional Committee, EDC 45 decided to 
take up this subject. 



Printtd at Primradt , Ntw Dalhi, India
